lines.text: Your sled reaches the caverns. Bram calls the mouth a route kept off city maps. A route can have more than one user.
Your stake records a hum rising from below its sensor. Below is a direction, not a distance.
Three viewpoints. A light in the fog. Ute sells you the viewpoints, not a verified road beyond the edge.
You recovered the named piece. The log gives a window before Directorate arrival. Ask who watches the other sled. That's the road.
Recovery record says where. Named salvage, not whatever fits on your sled. That's the road.
Fall's due. I'll be there. Race you. Loser carries.
Wall-folk on a sled. Sit down, hold on, don't touch the brake.
